notes.title: Update v0.5.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Storage Anomaly - Patch 0.5.1[/h1]

Hey everyone! Here’s a small update with some fixes and tweaks to improve your experience. Thanks for your feedback and support! 🚀

[u]🔧 Improvements and fixes[/u]

 - An electrical outlet has been added upstairs to recharge the flashlight.
 - The elevator screws are now bigger for better visibility.
 - Fuses are now scattered on the floor and slightly enlarged.
 - The flashlight angle has been adjusted for better usability.
 - An anomaly has been modified to make it more visible, as it was too difficult in 0.5.0.
 - The screwdriver is now automatically unequipped after use.

Thanks for playing Storage Anomaly! Keep sharing your feedback on Discord 🎮

notes.title: Update v0.5.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Storage Anomaly - Patch 0.5.0[/h1]

Hello everyone! Here are the new features, changes, and improvements included in the 0.5.0 update of Storage Anomaly. Thank you for your feedback, which helps me improve the game!

[u]🔧 Improvements and new features[/u]

[u]🗺️ Map[/u]

- A second ventilation system has been added to the storage room.
- A sound effect now accompanies the store's flickering light.
- New decorative elements have been added to the map to enhance the environment and improve gameplay.
- Flies have been added above trash cans (+ sound effect) to bring more life to the storage area.
- New sounds have been added to enhance the elevator experience.
- The elevator has been redesigned for better immersion.

[u]🎮 Gameplay[/u]

- Players can now crouch by pressing CTRL or C.
- At the start of the game, the player faces a non-functional elevator, adding a challenge related to floor 0.
- A new achievement is available related to the elevator.
- In easy mode, the first five anomalies are always simpler to make the game more accessible.
- A pass that allows skipping an anomaly (usable once) can be purchased for 10$ (in-game currency) on the PC at floor 0.
- Remaining attempts in the keypad code are now displayed in real time.
- The enhanced flashlight is now more efficient for a better gameplay experience.
- The price of the enhanced flashlight is now 10$ (in-game currency), and the PC interface has been slightly modified.

[u]👁️ Anomalies[/u]

- Two new anomalies have been added, bringing the total number of anomalies to 33.

[u]⚙️ General[/u]

- Resolution settings are now locked in windowed fullscreen mode.
- The default flashlight's performance has been adjusted.
- Some textures have been modified for better graphical performance.

Thank you for playing Storage Anomaly and helping me refine the experience! Feel free to share your feedback on Discord ([https://discord.gg/rvNSSWKDMQ](https://discord.gg/rvNSSWKDMQ)). 🚀

notes.title: Update v0.3.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Storage Anomaly - Patch 0.3.0[/h1]

Hello everyone! Here are the new features, changes, and fixes included in the [b]0.3.0[/b] update of Storage Anomaly. Thank you for your feedback, which helps me improve the game!

[u]🐛 Bug Fixes[/u]

- The bug where the mouse would exit the screen has been fixed.
- The "LightsNeedToBeRebuilt" error message has been corrected and should no longer appear.

[u]🔧 Changes and Improvements[/u]

- Added sound and light effects to the elevator buttons.
- Updated the options menu to allow players to switch between fullscreen and windowed fullscreen modes.
- Added a horn to the pallet lift.
- Modified the achievement system with a message from the boss.
- Added fridge sounds in the store.
- Added ventilation and a fan in the storage room.
- Improved the PC screen in the office.
- Enhanced the bathroom to make it more realistic.
- Added an exterior light to bring more life outside the store.
- Added a dripping water sound effect in the bathroom.
- Adjusted the displayed time at the end of the game to show it in minutes.
- Added a light behind the break room door.
- Modified the keypad to lock for 120 seconds after 3 failed attempts.
- Updated the code for the electrical meter.
- [b]3 new anomalies![/b]

Thanks for playing Storage Anomaly and helping me refine the experience! Feel free to share your feedback on Discord ( https://discord.gg/rvNSSWKDMQ ). 🚀

notes.title: Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1][u]Storage Anomaly - [b]Patch 0.2.0[/b][/u][/h1]

Hello everyone! Here are the new features, changes, and fixes included in the [b]0.2.0[/b] update of Storage Anomaly. Thank you for your feedback, which helps me improve the game!

[u]🐛 Bug Fixes[/u]

- Fixed the bug where the fallen cardboard anomaly wouldn't reset.
- Corrected the invisible WC sign that still had an active collision.
- Fixed an issue where the battery would become incorrect when spamming the plug.
- Corrected a bug on the boss’s PC screen when double-clicking.
- Resolved a blockage in the reserve tables.

[u]🔧 Changes and Improvements[/u]

- Added the "Early Access" text to the game versions to clarify its status.
- Modified the AZERTY/QWERTY buttons to make them more understandable.
- The clues have been better hidden... And the code has changed.
- Displayed the selected language directly in the settings.
- The office plant has been removed.
- The display when you make a mistake in anomaly detection has been improved to make it more polished.
- The map has been slightly modified for better gameplay.
- Two difficulty modes have been added: Easy and Normal. The Easy mode allows you to revisit the default storage (as at the start of the game) after each failure, while the Normal mode does not let you revisit the default storage, and you must continue searching for a new anomaly.


Thanks for playing Storage Anomaly and helping me refine the experience! Feel free to share your feedback on Discord ( https://discord.gg/rvNSSWKDMQ ). 🚀
